findings: WHAT WITHOUT SO WHAT 2/2 spec sentences never say what the number does for the viewer. "2nm chip" is information; "faster without draining the battery" is relevance. (framework S7)
NUMBERS: one every 12.0 sentences. The playbook asks for one every 2-3 — concrete numbers are what make a claim feel reported rather than asserted.
